title: Initiative Authority Envelope
purpose: Treat explicit learner quieting, revocation, explanation, and restoration as scoped authority changes.
rules: Learner direction is final for the selected scope.
Remembered purpose cannot reactivate removed initiative.
Relevance inference cannot override explicit quieting or revocation.
Restoration requires a later explicit learner request.
Explanation uses bounded references rather than copied raw dialogue.
Authority changes do not authorize broader collection.
